tools.name: seo_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List every site/property visible to the configured tokens.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.title: Google search analytics
tools.description: Query GSC clicks/impressions/CTR/position by query, page, country or device.

tools.name: yandex_query_stats
tools.title: Yandex queries
tools.description: Top Yandex queries for a host with shows, clicks, position.

tools.name: yandex_indexing_state
tools.title: Yandex indexing state
tools.description: Indexing history, in-search page counts and diagnostics for a host.
limitations: per-URL sitemap errors are not exposed

tools.name: seo_crawl_site
tools.title: Crawl site
tools.description: Crawl a site (robots-respecting), return crawl summary and rule violations.

tools.name: seo_weekly_report
tools.title: Weekly report
tools.description: Build the weekly SEO digest (deltas vs last snapshot) for one property.

inputs.days: current period length in days (1..90, default 7)
inputs.lag_days: provider data lag in days (0..14, default 2)

tools.name: seo_report_diff
tools.title: Report diff
tools.description: Diff two stored weekly report snapshots (metrics, issues, opportunity churn).

inputs.base: older period START..END (default: second newest snapshot)
inputs.head: newer period START..END (default: newest snapshot)

tools.returns: {headline:[{metric,base,head,abs_delta,pct_delta}], unknown_metrics, issues, opportunities:{added,resolved,unchanged}, limitations_changed, comparable, markdown}
limitations: needs two stored weekly snapshots (`lv24-seo init` + two report runs)
metrics present in one snapshot only are unknown, not zero

tools.name: seo_indexing_triage
tools.title: Indexing triage
tools.description: Group not-indexed URLs by reason and propose the cheapest fix.

tools.name: seo_log_analysis
tools.title: Analyze access log
tools.description: Parse one local nginx JSON access log and report bot crawl rollups and wasted share.

inputs.file: absolute path to one nginx JSON access log (max 100 MiB)
inputs.bot: optional bot filter: googlebot, yandexbot, bingbot or other

limitations: user-agent classification only; not a verified-crawler check
nginx JSON logs only; other formats are skipped
one local file per call; no rotation, glob or remote fetch

tools.name: seo_opportunities
tools.title: Opportunities
tools.description: Striking-distance queries, CTR gaps, decayed pages, cannibalisation candidates.

inputs.days: current period length in days (1..90, default 28)

tools.name: seo_recrawl_request
tools.title: Request recrawl (write)
tools.description: Queue URLs for Yandex recrawl within the daily quota.

inputs.plan_hash: plan_hash returned by the dry run (apply only)
inputs.confirm_token: confirm_token returned by the dry run (apply only)

limitations: apply needs the confirm_token from a dry run; a replay is skipped

tools.name: seo_sitemap_submit
tools.title: Submit sitemap (write)
tools.description: Submit or delete a sitemap in GSC/Bing.

inputs.plan_hash: plan_hash returned by the dry run (apply only)
inputs.confirm_token: confirm_token returned by the dry run (apply only)

limitations: apply needs the confirm_token from a dry run; a replay is skipped
